In figure $ABCEF$ shown above, which of the following are equal to the vector $\overset{\to }{BF}?$

- $\overset{\to }{BC}+\overset{\to }{CE}+\overset{\to }{EF}$
- $\overset{\to }{FA}-\overset{\to }{BA}$
- $\overset{\to }{BC}+\overset{\to }{CF}$
feedback.worked_solution:
- For the $1$st expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BC}+\overset{\to }{CE}+\overset{\to }{EF} & =(\overset{\to }{BC}+\overset{\to }{CE})+\overset{\to }{EF} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BE}+\overset{\to }{EF} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BF}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

- For the $2$nd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{FA}-\overset{\to }{BA} & =\overset{\to }{FA}+\overset{\to }{AB} \\  & =\overset{\to }{FB} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{BF}\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

- For the $3$rd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BC}+\overset{\to }{CF} & =\overset{\to }{BF}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and III only".
